action_items: Minor spec/testid mismatch (non-blocking): review_request mentions data-testid 'copy-compliance_badges-0' but the actual DOM uses section-prefixed id 'copy-compliance-compliance_badges-0' (CopyAdmin.jsx:79 → `copy-${section.key}-${field.key}`). Either update the brief or add an unprefixed alias for root-level fields.
Nit: service-card data-testid selector '[data-testid^="service-card-"]' matches 8 nodes (4 cards each with wrapper + inner element). If tests rely on exact=4, consider making one unique per card.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /admin/settings uses $set with {**doc, 'key': 'site'}; because SiteSettings model excludes `copy`, saving settings correctly preserves copy sub-doc. Good. However this still fully replaces chat/contact/tiers etc.; if a future field is added to any sub-model and an older client posts a payload missing it, the field will be silently dropped. Consider explicit sub-path $set.
server.py has grown to ~1860 lines mixing models, seeds, routes, and sitemap. Still exceeds the 700-line guideline — split into routes/, models/, seeds/ modules.

sitemap_xml route is mounted under api_router (/api/sitemap.xml). Production nginx must be configured to proxy /sitemap.xml → /api/sitemap.xml. Confirmed working via /api/sitemap.xml; direct /sitemap.xml not tested here.

update_site_copy stores entire SiteCopy without any migration/versioning. If SiteCopy schema evolves (new nested object), legacy docs will be re-serialized but any extra fields saved earlier will be dropped silently.
